sources.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent pixel-art character animation atlas for the Godot game Mosslight, not a scene or concept painting.
Reference image 1 is the approved moss-forest costume and pixel character identity. Create ONLY this little lantern keeper, keeping the sage round hood, brown grouped fringe, tiny dark block eyes, peach scarf, cream tunic, sage cloak, brown satchel and short brown boots. Handheld tiny brass warm-apricot lantern. No new accessories.
Canvas: exactly 1024 x 1024 RGBA with genuine transparent background. EXACT 4 columns x 4 rows of equal 256 x 256 cells, no drawn grid, no labels. Each sprite wholly inside its cell, same feet baseline at local y=224, body center local x=128, clear transparent gap. A sprite about 128 pixels wide including lantern and 192 pixels tall. Depict as if each cell is a 32x32 pixel sprite enlarged 8x with nearest neighbor: chunky visibly square pixel clusters, 1 logical pixel eyes, 2-3 discrete shades per material. No antialiasing, smooth gradients, knit texture, hair strands, big anime eyes or painted glow.
ROW 1: front/down direction; ROW 2: left direction; ROW 3: right direction; ROW 4: back/up direction with NO visible face.
Across EVERY row the four columns are: idle feet together, walk left foot forward, passing pose feet together with cloak shifted, walk right foot forward. All four must show the SAME direction for that row. Side views real side silhouettes, not front faces turned slightly. Back shows round hood and cloak back and small satchel. Hand lantern held consistently in character's left hand, can be occluded by body in side view. Tiny lighting confined to lamp glass; no background halo or shadow rectangle. Keep anatomy and scale consistent through all 16 cells. 16 separate full body animation frames. Pixel art, no text, watermark, scenery, contact sheet decorations.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent pixel-art character animation atlas for Mosslight.
Reference 1: approved STAR-NIGHT purple pointed hood costume. Reference 2: newly made moss-costume atlas giving exact body scale, face style, grid, pose cadence; this is a costume variant of SAME protagonist.
Create one 1024x1024 transparent RGBA PNG, EXACT 4 columns x 4 rows equally spaced, no grid/labels. Full bodies stay inside 256x256 cells with feet at local y=232 and body center x=128. Retain same body dimensions as reference2; hat point has extra height. Purple pointed hood with peach pompom, purple cape, cream tunic, peach neckcloth, brown boots and bag, tiny warm brass hand lantern. Tiny dark block eyes, brown fringe. Intentional chunky square pixel art, sparse 2-3 tone shading, equivalent 32x32 logical pixels per cell enlarged8x, never anime smooth shading.
Rows top to bottom MUST be: front/down; profile looking RIGHT (nose to right); profile looking LEFT (nose to left); rear/up (no face).
Columns: idle; left leg forward; passing feet; right leg forward. 16 distinct but tightly consistent frames, same baseline, same scale, no repeated 3/4 poses instead of profile. The back shows cape and back of hood. No scene, particles, halo, floor shadow, text, icons, inset, watermark. Genuine transparent background and transparent gutters. This is an engine-consumable sprite atlas, not an illustration board.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent production pixel-art garden sprite atlas for Mosslight, using attached approved forest reference only for palette and materials.
Canvas exactly1024x1024, 4 columns x4 rows, sixteen isolated sprites, equally spaced within256x256 cells, no visible grid. Transparent RGBA including gutters, NO backdrop, ground patch, floor shadow, text or labels. Crisp square chunky pixel clusters as low resolution 16bit game sprites, no smooth illustration, no blur, no external glow. Front three-quarter top-down RPG view as reference.
ROW1 four life stages of moon moss: tiny pale mint ground sprout; young LOW cushion with three lobes; fuller sprawling mint and sage moss cushion; ripe low cushion with 3 pale icy dew beads. ROOT stays at local center x128, baseline y200. All plants strictly low carpet no stalks no tall blue flowers. Width increases40,80,125,170px; maximum mature height70px. It will be imported at12px wide.
ROW2 four life stages glow bell: tiny two leaf sprout; short curved stalk with closed golden bud; a single drooping apricot bell; mature short two-bell plant with warm cream glasslike bell interiors. Rootx128,y220. Width40,80,120,165px, height40,90,140,180px. Compact readable leaves. No separate light halo.
ROW3 three states of SAME fixed lantern, same footprint and silhouette each centeredx128 basey232: col1 broken stone pedestal lantern with cracked dark empty chamber and partly damaged moss cap; col2 repaired but UNLIT intact dark chamber; col3 repaired glowing warm amber chamber. Stone cylindrical base, short stone pillar, broad moss roof. Total width150 height205. Must be visibly different states but same design. Col4 small tied peach cloth bag of pale golden lamp spores, no text.
ROW4 UI inventory icons, each centered, approximately128px wide: col1 single pale cyan dew drop; col2 cluster of three apricot golden round spores; col3 moon moss seed packet, muted teal cloth pouch with a tiny leaf mark, no writing; col4 glow-bell seed packet, peach cloth pouch with tiny bell mark, no writing.
Match the approved moss greens, deep teal shadows, cream highlights, peach and amber accents. These are reusable independent engine sprites, NOT a scene or labelled concept sheet. Each object fully isolated, generous transparent gutters, no overlap.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent environment prop sprite atlas for Mosslight, matches approved reference1 cozy moss forest and reference2 production garden props.
Create1024x1024 true transparent RGBA sprite sheet with EXACT2 columns and2 rows, four separated objects each inside a512x512cell. No grid, borders, text, labels, background scenery, standalone ground patches, halos or cast shadows. Pixel art for top down three-quarter cozy RPG. Deliberate square pixels and discrete grouped shading, not smoothly painted. Objects centered in each cell with minimum40px clear transparent gutter.
TOP LEFT: ONE small round cottage, rounded dark sage moss roof with little cream daisies, stone chimney, cream plaster walls, arched wooden door slightly right of center, circular warmly lit window to door's left, short stone doorstep, a small potted plant; match first reference identity. Roof not pointed, no purple. Main silhouette fits440wide x400high. Window decorative only, no area glow.
TOP RIGHT: ONE round-canopy ancient forest tree, clustered sage/teal foliage, dark teal lower canopy, warm brown visibly forked trunk and small roots; isolated, fits360wide x435high. Trunk base central, canopy entire.
BOTTOM LEFT: ONE low weathered hollow tree stump with ringed wood top, side roots and a small moss patch, width360height260. No animals, no lantern, no background.
BOTTOM RIGHT: ONE little decorative woodland plant cluster: three peach capped mushrooms, short stems beside several broad fern leaves, width320height245. No luminous spores or harvest sparkles.
Palette: muted sage/olive, deep teal-blue shadows, warm brown wood, creamy stone, warm apricot only inside window and mushroom caps. Crisp clustered pixel rendering consistent with garden atlas. All four are engine sprites, fully visible silhouette, genuine alpha, never a finished scene or UI.
